tagline: Short, calm brain-break activities for the classroom.

ads._comment: Off by default. Pupils are under 13: if you ever turn this on, ads are shown on the Home page only, at most one slot, child-directed and non-personalised. Read the 'Ads' section of README.md first.

watch._comment: A daily workflow (.github/workflows/new-activities.yml) checks these GitHub accounts for new Pages projects and opens a pull request adding them. Repository names in ignore are never suggested.
